subject: Recap + next step on pilot feasibility for Olive Labs
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step on pilot feasibility for Olive Labs

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking time yesterday to walk through Olive Labs' inference bottlenecks. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

Call highlights
- Primary constraint: inference tail latency at 95th percentile impacting user experience for the mobile app.
- Current infra: hybrid cloud with burst to public; interest in lowering per-token cost while keeping sub-200ms p95 for short queries.
- Key stakeholders: you (ML), Priya (Infra), and Marcus (Product).

Suggested pilot (attachment: pilot-scope-olivelabs.pdf)
- 2-week technical pilot using a representative subset (5M tokens/day sim)
- Metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, cold-start behavior, and KV cache hit rate
- Team commitment: 1 technical sync at kick-off + optional 30-min troubleshooting mid-pilot

Questions for you
1) Does the pilot scope align with how your team measures success?
2) What timelines are you working to (Q2/Q3)? Is there a target decision date?

If that sounds reasonable I can send a short trial plan (I attached a draft) and propose three kick-off slots next week. If you'd prefer, we can also do a brief tech-only sync with Priya to validate integration constraints.

Thanks — happy to adapt the scope to match constraints.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Quick follow-up —

Wanted to check in in case my note slipped through. We didn't hear back on scope or timing and I wanted to see whether this is still something you want to pursue this quarter. If not, a one-line update on expected timing is totally fine — we can pause and circle back later.

If helpful, I attached a packed trial plan (redwood-trial-plan.xlsx) that includes a proposed AMI/container spec, estimated infra costs for the 2-week run, and a short checklist for IT/Security to speed approvals. Happy to redact anything that looks prescriptive.

Would you prefer: 
- A 20-min tech sync to validate integration feasibility, or
- An estimate-first approach (we send pricing + compliance docs, you share availability later)

Appreciate any guidance.

Thanks,
Hiro

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan.xlsx
From: Sara Lopez <sara@olivelabs.com>

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next step on pilot feasibility for Olive Labs

Thanks for the follow-up, Hiro — appreciate the clear summary.

Short update from our side: we had an internal reprioritization this week and are pausing new vendor evaluations for the remainder of Q2. That said, the problem you highlighted is accurate and we do expect to revisit vendor options in early Q3 when planning our reliability workstream.

A few asks so we have a lane to pick this back up later: could you send over an indicative monthly pricing range for the pilot scale you proposed and a copy of your SOC2 report / info on data residency? If you can drop those into the same HubSpot deal record or email them here, I'll ensure Priya and Marcus see them.

Also — feel free to ping again early July to reopen.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Head of Machine Learning, Olive Labs
sara@olivelabs.com | +1 (628) 555-0199
